vectors.name: cell_straddle_high
vectors.note: x = 20 + 0.6 grid cells, snaps UP — differs from cell_straddle_low although the inputs are only 2e-8 apart. vectors.name: grid9e5_baseline
vectors.note: unit square at a coarse ~10m grid — exercises the recipe at a non-default gridsize (grid is a function parameter, not a constant). ADVISORY: coarse-grid ST_ReducePrecision is GEOS-build-sensitive (GEOS 3.9.0 → ec0ce2…, Cloud SQL GEOS 3.11.4 → this digest); pinned to the Cloud SQL production stack.

vectors.name: grid9e5_jitter
vectors.note: 1e-6 jitter, below the 9e-5 grid — collapses to grid9e5_baseline (same_as holds on GEOS 3.11.4 too). ADVISORY: shares grid9e5_baseline's GEOS-build-sensitive coarse-grid digest, pinned to the Cloud SQL production stack.
